title: The Puzzle Sky with Many Blues
youtube_title: The Puzzle Sky with Many Blues | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Finishing together matters more than finishing first.
summary: At a garden row with string and two watering cans, a puzzle sky full of almost-matching blues will go wrong if one person rushes. Yelena and Cosima split it into two slow jobs, while Miss Dalca only offers a count or a name for the knot they need. They finish together.
